title: Understanding the Node.js Event Loop
content: Node.js uses a single-threaded event loop with non-blocking I/O to handle thousands of concurrent connections efficiently without thread overhead.

title: CommonJS require() and module.exports
content: CommonJS is Node's original module system. require() synchronously loads and evaluates a module, caching the exported module.exports object.

title: Express Middleware Pipeline
content: Middleware functions have access to (req, res, next). Calling next() passes execution to the next handler; calling next(err) jumps to the error handler.
